Meta tags and viewport
Wide viewport Device-width viewport · Desktop · Mobile · Book Shop · Book Shop · Book A · Book A Book B · Book B
Read the diagram step by step

Viewport metadata allows the layout viewport to match the device width. Responsive CSS
can then change columns to a single column. The meta tag alone does not make a page
responsive.
Viewport meta tag එකෙ mobile device width එකෙ භාවි+ කෙරන්න උදෙව් කෙරනවා. CSS media queries වJගේ Jදේවලින් columns එකෙ column එකෙකෙට හරවන්න පුළුවන්. Meta tag එකෙ වි+රකේ පේ‍රමාණවත් නුහු.
